baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence adbara yas'a joins a back-turn to ongoing directed motion.
baseline_models.mechanism: The completed turn opens into an imperfect verb of purposeful movement, so withdrawal is an energetic transition rather than the end of action.

activation_trace.role: Turning the back and withdrawing supplies the directional reversal at the start of the action.
Purposeful movement toward a sought end makes the departure urgent and goal-bearing.

changed_reading.after: Then he turned his back while moving urgently toward an objective; the retreat itself launches further action.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Adbara marks disengagement, while yas'a can denote sustained work or conduct rather than speed alone.
baseline_models.mechanism: The two verbs form a pivot from encounter to enterprise: he withdraws from what faced him and begins an unspecified course of work.

activation_trace.role: Aversion and turning away separate the agent from the preceding encounter.
Work, earning, and active conduct turn the second verb into an enterprise rather than mere locomotion.

changed_reading.after: He disengaged from the encounter and immediately set to work on an as-yet unspecified counter-course.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The packet gives yas'a a secondary mapped target whose live branch is neglected, directionless going.
baseline_models.mechanism: That form-distant branch weakens the usual goal-directed force of yas'a and lets the paired verbs depict casting oneself away without governance.

activation_trace.role: Turning the back supplies the initial rejection and outward direction.
Neglect and going on one's face supply an uncontrolled alternative to purposeful striving.

changed_reading.before: He turned away in purposeful haste.
changed_reading.after: He turned away and cast himself into headlong, ungoverned going.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening advances through willing activation, coursing movement, precedence, and management of an affair; the focus reuses that kinetic energy but reverses its orientation through adbara, producing an anti-procession of energetic misdirection.

activation_trace.role: The back-turn reverses the direction of the opening movement pattern.
Purposeful motion preserves the opening sequence's energy inside the reversal.
Readiness and willing activity establish energized action as the opening sequence's first motion image.
Running or swimming extends that energy into sustained coursing movement.
Advancing and outstripping give the movement a forward competitive direction.
Consultation and management of an affair supply a coordinated endpoint for the opening movement.

structural_cues: 79:1-5 is an accelerating sequence of paired actions culminating in management of an affair.
79:5 also repeats the focus root د ب ر in mudabbirat; because that context root is not in context_root_cues, the repetition is used only as a structural cue.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies advancing motion, managed action, and the uncited د ب ر repetition; I supply the contrastive arrow that makes the focus a reversed or usurped version of that order. A live alternative is incidental lexical recurrence with no designed inversion.

changed_reading.before: An individual turns away and moves urgently.
changed_reading.after: His urgent back-turn becomes a counter-procession: organized energy is retained but redirected against the surah's opening image of ordered advance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding sequence defines one offered trajectory from transgression toward purification, guidance, and awe, then supplies a displayed sign and explicit rejection; adbara yas'a therefore becomes a chosen reversal away from that route followed by effort in the opposite direction.

activation_trace.role: Turning the back makes the offered trajectory relationally reversible, not merely spatial.
Directed movement makes the rejection continue as an alternative trajectory.
Exceeding the limit in disobedience supplies the initial condition the offered route is meant to change.
Purity and rectification supply the first destination from which the focus turns away.
Gentle direction toward a road or truth makes the rejected alternative explicitly path-like.
Fear joined with awe supplies the intended inward result of guidance.
Showing and making visible establish that the turn follows disclosure rather than ignorance.
A manifest sign gives the disclosure a concrete evidentiary function.
Assigning falsehood converts the seen sign into an object of explicit rejection.
Departure from obedience turns rejection into enacted opposition immediately before the focus.

structural_cues: 79:17-21 moves from diagnosis through offered change and visible evidence to rejection immediately before 79:22.
The focus particle thumma marks the back-turn as a subsequent stage rather than a simultaneous reflex.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two opposed states, guidance language, disclosure, and rejection; I infer that the physical direction of adbara maps onto that offered ethical route and that yas'a continues the rejection. The materially live alternative is literal departure after refusal with no path metaphor.

changed_reading.before: He actively withdrew after the encounter.
changed_reading.after: After seeing and refusing an offered route toward purification and awe, he deliberately reversed away from it and spent his agency on the contrary route.

context_deltas.mechanism: The following actions resolve the unspecified work of yas'a: gathering people, raising a public call, and asserting supreme lordship make the back-turn a transition from failed encounter to organized power performance.

activation_trace.role: Withdrawal closes the direct encounter and opens a different arena of action.
Work and active conduct let the next actions specify what the striving accomplishes.
Office exercised over a people supplies a specifically governmental branch for the ensuing mobilization.
Driving and gathering a group toward one purpose gives the striving a collective object.
A raised public call turns collection of the crowd into performed communication.
Lordship, ownership, and sovereignty identify the authority being performed.
Exaltation joined to domination supplies the vertical claim that crowns the mobilization.

structural_cues: 79:23-24 follows the focus with tightly linked fa-actions: gather, call, then proclaim.
The subject remains continuous across the focus and the following action chain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the immediate acts and the focus supplies an otherwise open-ended striving; I infer that the later acts are the operational content or goal of that striving. The live alternative is that yas'a describes only hurried transit before a separately initiated assembly.

changed_reading.before: He withdrew to undertake an unspecified counter-project.
changed_reading.after: He turned from the encounter into political work: mobilizing a crowd, broadcasting a claim, and performing sovereign dominance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate seizure, exemplary punishment, temporal bracketing of latter and first, and resulting lesson activate dabr as an act's last consequence: his striving does not merely follow the turn but manufactures the aftermath into which he is taken.

activation_trace.role: The last part and ensuing consequence let the back-turn carry a secondary aftermath horizon.
Work and conduct make the agent an active producer of what follows.
Being taken to account for wrongdoing supplies the consequence that arrests the striving.
Punishment that deters others converts an individual end into a public warning.
Latter-ness after what came first supplies one edge of the punishment's temporal span.
Beginning and precedence supply the other edge of the first-and-latter span.
Taking one condition as a lesson for another makes the aftermath transferable to observers.

structural_cues: 79:25 begins with an immediate fa-result after the gathering and proclamation sequence.
79:26 converts the completed sequence into an explicit lesson for another audience.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies action, seizure, punishment, temporal span, and lesson; I supply the causal arrow by which his own striving produces the dabr or aftermath that catches him. The alternative is that B002 remains inactive and the punishment is only a later event.

changed_reading.before: He turns away to pursue his project.
changed_reading.after: He labors into his own aftermath: the counter-project produces the consequence that arrests him and preserves his end as a warning.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later sequence recalls what a person strove for, exposes the destination, repeats transgression, identifies a governing preference, and ends at an abode; this converts the focus motion into durable, classifiable work whose endpoint will become visible.

activation_trace.role: The ending and consequence branch gives the focus act a horizon beyond its immediate scene.
Work and conduct allow the same striving to persist as an accountable deed.
Recollection after possible forgetting supplies the later retrieval of past striving.
Disclosure and emergence into view make the striving's destination publicly manifest.
Transgressing the limit classifies the type of agent whose striving the following outcome evaluates.
Preference by deliberate choice supplies an inner selection that directs the outward striving.
Joining a containing destination supplies the terminal abode reached by the remembered course.

structural_cues: 79:35 repeats سعى, the focus's second lexeme, but that context occurrence is kept structural because س ع ي is not in context_root_cues.
79:37 repeats طغى from 79:17, linking the narrative diagnosis to the later general classification.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the exact striving echo, later recollection, exposure, repeated transgression, preference, and abode; I infer that the particular striving at 79:22 is an instance of the later accountable category. The alternative is that 79:35-39 states only a general rule without retrospectively coloring this scene.

changed_reading.before: His striving is a political project confined to the immediate narrative.
changed_reading.after: His striving is also a durable deed-entry: a chosen course later recalled, exposed, classified as transgression, and carried to its abode.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses from the focus QAC root س ع ي to the packet's secondary mapped target س و ع and then to the Hour cue at 79:42. It remains anchored because both occurrences resolve to root_000760 B002 in the packet, but downstream prose must label it a branch-level resonance rather than an etymological identity or direct translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The secondary target of yas'a supplies neglected, headlong going, while adbara supplies the initiating turn away.

activation_trace.role: Turning away supplies the focus action that enters the alternative mode of going.
Neglect and going on one's face recast purposeful striving as headlong abandonment.
The closing Hour cue reactivates the same mapped branch and places the headlong going under a terminal temporal horizon.

changed_reading.before: He turns away in purposeful pursuit.
changed_reading.after: At the packet's most branch-distant edge, he turns into neglected headlong going whose unrecognized horizon is the Hour.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it imports the distant follow-after mechanics of 79:7 into the bodily posture of 79:22. It remains valid as a whole-surah spatial motif anchored in dabr's back and yas'a's motion, not as local syntax; downstream prose should qualify it as a pursuit image rather than assert that the verse says he was chased.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Adbara exposes the agent's back and yas'a propels him onward, allowing earlier follow-after branches to occupy the space behind him.

activation_trace.role: The back or what lies behind supplies the spatial position from which a follower can approach.
Purposeful rapid movement supplies the attempt to put distance ahead of what follows.
Following in another's wake supplies motion that remains behind yet tracks the mover.
Something arriving immediately after another sharpens the image of an inescapable follower.
Seizure and capture supply the eventual closure of the imagined pursuit.

changed_reading.before: He turns his back and hastens away.
changed_reading.after: His haste places him ahead of a follow-after force that eventually catches him, so apparent escape becomes the opening posture of pursuit.

strongest_changes: The immediate context turns generic haste into a deliberate reversal of an offered path and then specifies the striving as crowd mobilization and sovereign performance.
The later repetition of سعى converts the scene's motion into durable conduct that can be recalled, exposed, classified, and brought to an endpoint.
The aftermath branches of د ب ر let the back-turn function secondarily as the act that produces the consequence preserved as a warning.
summary.what_was_special: The focus holds active retreat and counter-enterprise in two compact verbs. Whole-surah repetitions of د ب ر and س ع ي activate an opening inversion and a later record-of-deeds reading, while the packet's split mapping to س و ع preserves a deliberately contained Hour resonance.
remaining_uncertainties: Yas'a can remain literal urgent movement, denote the political work disclosed in 79:23-24, or carry both values at once.
The consequence sense of د ب ر is secondary to the direct back-turn form, so the self-made-aftermath model depends on a reader-supplied causal overlay.
The opening counter-procession, pursuit motif, and split-root Hour resonance may be productive whole-surah echoes rather than designed lexical signals.
